scope: Current bounded APIs, specification ownership and test mapping. This inventory is not execution or whole-game compatibility evidence.

families.contract: F01 §§1–6; X02 controlled choices; architecture ownership
families.publicSurface: Arithmetic/WrappingI32; cancellation; content hashes and names; identity counters; generated/controlled random contexts, samples, traces and restore
families.review: Full integer/binary64 boundary vectors and sampling populations, constant zero-draw cases, choice failure prefixes, independent restore and overflow limits. Versioned PCG32 policy; normal .NET floating environment is required. Callbacks use delegates and interfaces.

families.publicSurface: ByteReader/Writer; explicit endian fields; CoreInput/Output Close/Item/Byte; IFileStorage read/replace/remove
families.review: Bounds and truncation offsets, short accepted prefixes, close once, disposal after failure. Explicit IDisposable lifetimes and owned results.

families.contract: M1 command/session contracts; F05 accepted choices
families.publicSurface: Player identities, command schemas and typed values, closed choices, own-unit/city observations, setup/provider interfaces
families.review: Owned observation copies, descriptor validation and client isolation. Native public-API reflection and project checks replace move-only/static link assertions.

families.publicSurface: Accepted game/graphics/message options; double movement; multiplayer option continuation begin/poll/cancel/dispose and proposal
families.review: All 31 predecessor cases mapped in configuration-coverage.md: exact bytes, child ordering, retained failure prefixes, host gates, signed deadlines, cancellation and cleanup. Owned proposal text replaces presentation scratch.

families.publicSurface: Stable unit/city pools, reservations/deletion/reset/renewal, tokens, retained scan bounds, cached city workspace
families.review: First holes, extension limits and unsupported admission; retained payload and copied values; token wrap including zero; independent world lifetimes; mood workspace dispatch.

families.contract: F02 ownership; X01 fresh-world/text repair; F05/F06 retained values
families.publicSurface: ProcessContext/GameState, world lifetime, history/layout/scenario/setup/text state, owned rule and label text
families.review: Independent process/world values and explicit reset/default behavior. Owned text retains complete names independently of classic ordinals; historical allocation extents and pointer lifetimes are intentionally not reproduced.

families.contract: F02 civilization fields; V03 knowledge; F06 census/post-load
families.publicSurface: Civilization/global records; knowledge sentinels; loaded-unit counts and real post-load cleanup
families.review: Owned copies, exact ordered census failure prefixes and knowledge bounds; changing scan limits and supplied elimination/deletion effects.

families.publicSurface: Event presence/aliases, append/copy/compact/install; stored events and live output
families.review: Absent versus present-empty text, alias holes, stable IDs and staged install; truncations and opaque retained metadata. S02 parser/executor remains a required supplied child.

families.publicSurface: Ordinary/multiplayer preference values/defaults, stored codecs/live conversions, load/save/default staging
families.review: Every bit/offset and partial item, opaque text tails, default/close failure, output failures/removal, snapshots before I/O, once-only cleanup and publication.

families.publicSurface: Logical saved passwords and presence flags; adapter-owned password encoding, reset padding and loaded-mode adaptation
families.review: All source password bits and circular seam, semantic choice failure prefix and retained byte 255, equal-mode gate and retained current values; PCG generated policy intentionally changed.

families.contract: W01 geometry/spatial state; F06 map input
families.publicSurface: Geometry indices/canonical coordinates/wrap/distance/neighbors/regions; MapStorage allocate/release/swap/layers/lookup/features/mutate/sync; staged MapInput install
families.review: Parity aliases, signed wrapping/overflow, half-open rectangles, ordered duplicate neighborhoods, allocation/admission, retained direct layers, current resource seed, synchronization routes and failure prefixes. Semantic feature components and civilization sets; classic operand reduction and opaque-only publication are adapter responsibilities.

families.publicSurface: Typed rule operands/tables, all normalization helpers, ordered per-table installation and reload/name retention
families.review: All cosmic limits, signed byte/word wrapping, disabled advance fixup, order/dependencies and failure prefixes; owned semantic names and marker conversion replace original pool ordinals.

families.publicSurface: Layered name catalog selection and city preference admission/apply; classic/native readers
families.review: Owned layers and cursors, exact NoDefend/list retention, unknown tokens/capacity limits, section retries and close-once/failure prefixes.

families.publicSurface: Default city-name selection over native/classic catalogs and owned rule names
families.review: All local/shared/fallback cursor paths, duplicate-name retries and failed publication; complete owned names independent of labels and allocation timing.

families.contract: A01 shared goals; F01 arithmetic; U04 supplied movement queries
families.publicSurface: Priority negate/lookup, standing reset, add current/standing, refresh, clear nearby goals
families.review: Gaps/order/ties, duplicate roles, signed priorities and distances, child query failures, retained redirects. No complete AI claim.

families.publicSurface: CalendarYear over classic/custom profiles and scenario/launch adjustments
families.review: Every profile boundary, signed wrapping and negative input, explicit custom values and pure observation without random draws.

families.publicSurface: Stack traversal/repair, detach/attach/front/bottom/relocate and whole-stack ordering
families.review: 2048 repair bound, cycles/missing links, valid-prefix effects, captured successors, optional diagnostics and independently gated synchronization.

families.publicSurface: UnitDeletion erase and supplied order/production/elimination effects
families.review: Signed bookkeeping, sleepers and link cleanup, captured observations, required providers and failure prefixes. No unimplemented U04/V01 expansion.

families.publicSurface: Bounded local/remote primitive and whole-stack operation poll/cancel/result; command composition
families.review: Normalized request padding, yielded replies, signed deadlines and post-timeout drain, ownership changes, callback cancellation, explicit world pin release.

families.publicSurface: Fixed text and unit/city/tile/region/global record codecs, raw field inventory, stored/live compatibility metadata
families.review: Exact field offsets, signed and unsigned views, unused bits and text tails; reject truncation/extra bytes and out-of-range logical exports without truncation. Logical Unicode text, paired MapPoint locations and carrier references are tested separately from fixed CP1252 fields and stored coordinate layouts. Nullable slot references canonicalize absence in core; unchanged imported negative encodings survive adapter export, and slot zero remains present.

families.publicSurface: Classify/decode/encode admitted saves and raw maps; exact stream/header order and optional blocks
families.review: All byte truncations, versions 0x26/27/28/2c, opaque separator/trailers and optional events; 0x2c-only inspection remains distinct from low-level codec domain.

families.contract: F06 stored/live adapters and output sections
families.publicSurface: Entity/global/leader/history/layout/scenario/multiplayer conversions; owned GameInput and live section writers
families.review: Opaque metadata bound to actual world lifetime, semantic custom-name sign restoration/export, selected-tribe repeated effects; staged validation and byte-prefix failures. Game status and tiles use semantic state; unknown game/terrain/radius bits remain in world/map-bound adapter metadata.

families.publicSurface: Owned read windows, physical seek, token/number/section/indexed search and selected/home fallback
families.review: Repeated headers/current cursor versus indexed lookup, byte controls, non-ASCII fold policy, source ownership, malformed tokens and failure-state retention.

families.publicSurface: Classic rule section decoding to typed operands; semantic rule validation
families.review: All sections, vocabularies/defaults and numeric normalization; reload/retained names, titles/text and selection/child failure prefixes.

families.publicSurface: Label catalog decode/load/install; popup defaults; language/cache initialization
families.review: Owned staged inputs, declared count and backed indices, cached fallback, cleanup, full-width text references and language wrapping; no native dialog implementation.

families.contract: Content data/gameplay format; F03 native operands
families.publicSurface: Strict JSON values/integers, trusted gameplay definitions, explicit source identities and descriptor admission
families.review: Duplicate/unknown fields, exact large integers, classic restrictions/custom gate, canonical normalization and owned content.

families.publicSurface: Ordered mount/parent/locale resolution, pinned content receipts and budgets
families.review: Parent cycles/revisions, whole-group fallback, nested gameplay, hash validation, owned media and deterministic precedence.

families.contract: M1 content conversion; F03/C01 classic inputs

families.review: Complete typed output, reload rejection, all cursor windows and effects, limits/admission and truthful partial publication; formatting differences explicitly normalized in differential evidence.

families.review: Ordered filters, missing paths, deferred live capture, pending command deadlines, failed chooser/notice children and released pins.

families.review: All 15 registered operations and 57 fixtures; seven explicit PCG replacements, unchanged controlled fixtures, full observation/consumed-prefix equality, stale/missing-input rejection. No whole-game claim.
